# Yogesh Bhusara

> Product designer (UI/UX) specializing in enterprise SaaS, collaboration, productivity, and complex product systems. Based in Pune, India. Currently Sr. UI/UX Designer at MangoApps.

## About

- Name: Yogesh Bhusara
- Role: Product Designer / Senior UI/UX Designer
- Location: Pune, India
- Experience: 13+ years
- Focus: Design systems, enterprise UX, AI-assisted prototyping
- Current employer: MangoApps (enterprise intranet and employee experience platform)
- Previous: Tata Communications, Appnocrat Technology (Therapy Box), Probity Venture
- Toolkit: Figma, Cursor, Claude, SwiftUI, Xcode
- Email: yogesh.bhusara@outlook.com
- Site: https://yogeshbhusara.com/

## What he designs

Enterprise collaboration and productivity products — dashboards, planning workflows, content governance, task management, design systems, and mobile experiences. He works end-to-end with product and engineering: research, flows, UI specs, and platform-wide consistency.

## Selected work

- Post Planning Calendar & Post Ideas (2024) — Content planning layer for a SaaS intranet (calendar, Post Ideas, scheduling, CSV import)
- User Segment Based Dashboards (2024) — Personalized dashboard experiences for employee segments
- Object Review, Approve & Publish Workflow (2024) — Content governance for enterprise publishing
- Centralized Task Management (2024) — Task orchestration for distributed retail / front-line teams
- Buuzz App (2022) — Dock-free e-bike sharing app for Indian cities
- Yugen (2024) — Brand identity for a full-stack AI / ML services company

Case studies: https://yogeshbhusara.com/work.html
